The All Progressives Congress (APC) Presidential Campaign Council (PCC), has scheduled its inaugural meeting on Tuesday at the Presidential Campaign Council HQ Plot 781, Herbert Macaulay Way, Central Business District, Abuja.
This is contained in a notice issued by the Secretary of the Council and govenror of Imo state, Senator Hope Uzodimma on Sunday night.
According to the notice, the meeting is strictly by invitation to the list of attendees which are the leadership and members of the campaign council.
“You are hereby invited to the inaugural meeting of the APC Presidential Campaign Council, scheduled to hold as follows: Date: Tuesday, 20th, October 2026 Time: 2 PM Prompt Venue: PRESIDENTIAL CAMPAIGN COUNCIL HQ Plot 781, Herbert Macaulay Way, Central Business District (Central Area), Abuja. Attendance: Directors and Secretaries of Directorates
“Kindly note that the meeting is strictly by invitation and is open only to the 134 members of the Presidential Campaign Council listed below.
“The meeting will formally commence the collective assignment of the Council and provide an opportunity to consider and adopt the Campaign Calendar, as well as to deliberate on other ancillary matters, including preparations for the flag-off of the campaign scheduled to hold in Kaduna on Saturday, 24th October 2026,” the notice read.
